item.p: Packets 8.9 (schema-informed grammars and typed values: every schema and xsd-types-only golden case in both directions; ratchet 3,789) and 8.15 (Processor.encodeExi and parseExi; 100 golden checks in JavaScript) landed ().
Packet 8.14 (sxml encode, sxml decode, --input-format=exi) landed: check-command 206 of 206, the book chapter's 16 examples, the gate with the wasm tests ().

Packet 8.13 (EXI through the processor) landed: the exi feature, exi:serialize and exi:parse, the exi:exi output method from XQuery and XSLT, the options reader, the schemaId resolver; tools/exi/check-processor.py passes 151 of 151 checks ().

8.6 and 8.8 done (): pre-compression and compression in both directions (blocks, the structure channel, value channels read and written in the order of EXI 9.3, our DEFLATE): every decode check of the six sets passes (720), pre-compression encodes byte for byte, and EXIficient decodes every compressed stream sxml writes to the same document as its own (tools/exi-oracle/cross-check.py: 480 of 480). The ratchet lists 2,880 checks.
8.5 done (): the encoder with built-in grammars writes every stream of the six schema-less sets byte for byte as EXIficient does (720 of 720); the ratchet lists 1,440 checks.

8.7 done (): sxml inflate and deflate from RFC 1951, deflate_vectors 422 of 422 under the sanitizers (allocation sweeps included); deflate within 1 % of zlib level 6 on the text vectors (text 5,031 against 5,031 bytes). The repeat-first vector was wrong (canonical codes go by symbol order, RFC 1951 3.2.2) and is fixed.

8.4 decode (): the built-in grammars, string tables and bit streams; every decode check of bit-packed, bit-packed-full, byte-alignment-full, string-limits, string-limits-zero and fragment passes (720 of 720) and is in the ratchet. Typed datatypes move to 8.9, where schemas need them.

8.1 and 8.2 done (): include/sxml/exi.h and the additive serialize.h, name.h and processor.h changes; the EXIficient oracle, the golden corpus of tests/exi (every option set), the driver exi_golden with its ratchet, and tools/exi/check-packet.sh.

The JavaScript package gets a release step (): a pushed tag runs .github/workflows/npm.yml, which builds, tests, packs and smoke-tests @tinyactors/sxml from the tag and stages it on npm; 0.2.0 was never published (npm answered 404).
